reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Lines of Zahn prove antemortem thrombus formed in flowing blood
Most pulmonary emboli arise from proximal leg deep veins
White infarcts occur in solid organs with end arterial supply
Factor V Leiden resists activated protein C
reference.pathophysiology: Endothelial injury exposes collagen and tissue factor, activating platelets and coagulation. Stasis prevents dilution of activated factors, while inherited or acquired hypercoagulability lowers the threshold for clot formation. Detached thrombus fragments travel as emboli until vessel calibre traps them.
additionalDifferentials: Thromboembolism versus fat or amniotic fluid embolism
additionalInvestigations: Compression ultrasound for deep vein thrombosis
CT pulmonary angiography for suspected pulmonary embolism
Thrombophilia testing only in selected unprovoked or unusual site thrombosis
